csv_scope_of_work: The Ashtabula County Board of Commissioners is requesting Statements of Qualifications (SOQs) from qualified design professionals and firms providing professional architectural and engineering (A/E) services . Consultants may be selected and pre-qualified to provide services for the following purposes: Architectural and engineering planning services Conceptual planning and feasibility studies Facility planning for renovation and construction projects Detailed design and preparation of construction contract documents Construction cost estimating Construction administration services Mechanical and/or electrical design of equipment installation or modification within County facilities Preparation of detailed plans, specifications, material lists, schematic drawings, and process design memorandums
